info.title: Bartr Marketplace API Design
info.description: Phase1 design contract, not implemented endpoints. Authoritative FastAPI behind existing Next same-origin /api rewrite. Public/private projections, retry and concurrency details in ../data-model.md and matching-and-ui.md. Money is integer cents; percentage is display only. Production uses __Host-bartr_session; the documented cookie name is localhost. All authenticated mutations require Origin/CSRF; command mutations also require idempotency. Revisions and terms_hash are server-validated. Default errors never contain private text, credentials or raw provider payloads.

get.description: Only the actor can look up its key. Completed/rejected receipt returns200. Missing or not-yet-provable receipt returns202 outcome=unresolved, never a fabricated failure. Query/retry the same original key; do not create a replacement key.

sessionCookie.name: bartr_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque session identifier. Production cookie __Host-bartr_session has Secure,HttpOnly,SameSite=Lax,Path=/ and no Domain. An anonymous session is sufficient only for bootstrap/register/login; every other protected route needs a member.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must equal an explicitly allowed frontend origin, including register/login.

CSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRF.description: Session-bound synchronizer token returned by GET auth/session.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per member across mutations. Reuse identical method/path/body/expected revision on retry; different request with same key409. Resolve replay receipt before current If-Match.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted resource revision. Missing428; stale412 with current revision, except identical idempotent replay returns original outcome.

NotFound.description: Absent or unauthorized private resource; no existence/content leak.

PreconditionFailed.description: The reviewed resource revision or terms_hash changed; reload and review before a new command.

Unavailable.description: Dependency, semantic artifacts, index completeness or capacity unavailable. Codes distinguish assistance_unavailable, invalid_provider_output, semantic_index_unavailable, generation_incomplete, capacity_exceeded and database_unavailable.

Exclusion.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed. Separate exclusions are ORed. Canonical, member-confirmed values only; no empty predicate.

Valuation.description: Null is unknown, never zero. Known values require source owner/assisted and a date. Source unknown requires amount/date null.

OfferPreview.description: Preview hash is recomputed before submission/counteroffer from reviewed terms; once stored, an offer's hash is immutable. Acceptance compares the stored current offer hash and separately revalidates current hard-policy history/eligibility. Compatible policy or soft preference edits do not change immutable offer terms.

RecommendationResult.description: no_match requires complete evaluation of current eligible pilot inventory. Missing/stale artifacts, unavailable dependencies or deadline return an error, never no_match.

current_required_warnings.description: Computed disclosure for the acting viewer's next action, without mutating the immutable offer hash. Acknowledge these codes on acceptance.

ValuationInput.description: Source and last-set time are server-owned. An analysis_id must belong to this owner/item/current source revision. Unchanged accepted saved estimate is labeled assisted; changed/manual amount is owner-entered; null is unknown. Arbitrary source/date claims are rejected.

ItemDraftFacts.description: Owner-only incomplete draft facts, using server-computed valuation provenance. Publication validates the complete ItemFacts shape.

AnalysisSuggestions.description: Backend-validated advisory fields only. Catalog values must belong to the supplied catalog. Saved analysis_id proves owner/item/source revision; suggestions do not update confirmed item facts.

x-contract-rules.privacy: Private responses no-store. IDs are never authorization. Published available listings exclude owner-only fields; reviewed historical image/snapshot access is restricted to participants.
x-contract-rules.versions: Every protected state-changing item/member/preference/trade command revalidates stored revision. Notes increment trade revision. Image attachment also increments item and trading revisions. Analysis never overwrites confirmed facts.
x-contract-rules.knownValues: Each amount_cents <=10^12 to keep bundle arithmetic within safe browser integer bounds; amount null remains unknown and cannot be zero. Gap eligibility is exact cents cross-multiplication with bps, not rounded gap_percentage.
x-contract-rules.unresolved: An unknown commit returns202 only after the command has a stable actor-scoped key. Receipt and effect are transactional; missing receipt cannot prove failure. No success is claimed while unresolved.
x-contract-rules.warnings: Preview/submission identify warnings. Both senders and acceptors acknowledge the warnings shown for their current action. Preview terms_hash is recomputed on submission/counteroffer; acceptance compares the immutable stored hash plus current hard eligibility. Compatible policy or soft preference edits alone never change the offer hash. Current warnings can be displayed separately without revising the offer or bypassing hard constraints.
x-contract-rules.valuationProvenance: Clients submit amount_cents and optional analysis_id only. Backend owns source/date. Saved, owner/item/revision-bound unchanged AI estimates can be assisted; edits become owner values. Null is unknown.
